build: Explicit reviewed Babel CLI with unchanged canonical Babel configuration, no package prepare hook or release task
category_identity: commitizen/cz-cli and commitizen-tools/commitizen are independently maintained different language implementations, not forks or separate commands of one repository. Conceptual naming overlap supplies no additional shared-case credit.
execution_scope: Trusted synthetic configuration/message fixtures only; no npm init/install adapter mode, commit hooks, real repositories, commits, tags, pushes or services in target tests.
first_workflow: Documented git-cz --hook --allow-empty writes a conventional commit message into an owned synthetic Git fixture without creating a commit. Standard upstream cz-conventional-changelog adapter only.
hooks_suppressed: fsevents install (optional platform package, never executed)
install: npm ci --ignore-scripts --bin-links=false --no-audit --no-fund, owned caches/homes/config/prefix; canonical production lock and exact derived Babel-only lock
node_requirement: >=18; use installed read-only prerequisite and hash-verified owned executable copy
retention_forecast: Retain canonical source, exact locks, primary integrity records and owned npm cache tarballs; runtime/build catalogs. Do not retain copied Node binary or expanded node_modules after qualification.
